## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task satisfies the documentation requirement for the new dispatcher architectural pattern approved in the Step 2 architectural review. No explicit story DD owns this task but new patterns require ADR per project standards.

## TDD Requirement
TDD Exemption: criterion #3 — static documentation asset (Markdown ADR), no executable assertion possible. Structural existence check used.

## Implementation Steps
Create `docs/adr/0012-merge-to-main-dispatcher-pattern.md` following the format of existing ADRs (e.g., docs/adr/0009-config-system.md):

Sections to include:
- **Title**: ADR 0012: Dispatcher/Strategy Pattern for merge-to-main.sh
- **Status**: Accepted
- **Context**: merge-to-main.sh reached 1009 lines; adding PR-mode merge would push it past maintainability. Existing pattern: monolithic script with all logic inlined.
- **Decision**: Split into thin dispatcher (merge-to-main.sh) + strategy scripts (merge-to-main-direct.sh, merge-to-main-pr.sh). Dispatcher reads merge.strategy from dso-config.conf, execs appropriate strategy script.
- **Consequences**:
  - Each strategy script can be developed, tested, and reasoned about independently
  - External interface unchanged (same flags: --bump, --resume, --help)
  - State file gains merge_strategy field for cross-strategy --resume rejection
  - Future strategies add a new merge-to-main-{strategy}.sh without touching the dispatcher

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | tail -5
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] ADR file exists at docs/adr/0012-merge-to-main-dispatcher-pattern.md
  Verify: test -f docs/adr/0012-merge-to-main-dispatcher-pattern.md
- [ ] ADR contains Context, Decision, and Consequences sections
  Verify: grep -c -E '^##? (Context|Decision|Consequences)' docs/adr/0012-merge-to-main-dispatcher-pattern.md | awk '{exit ($1 < 3)}'
- [ ] ADR status is Accepted
  Verify: grep -q 'Status.*Accepted\|Accepted' docs/adr/0012-merge-to-main-dispatcher-pattern.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
